title: Doki theme manifest (doki.theme.json)
description: Declarative theme resources by default. Optional plugin entry runs theme code with the same plugin API.

templates.description: Directory of templates relative to the theme package root

layouts.description: Logical layout name → template path within templates/

defaults.description: Optional path to doki.defaults.toml (default: doki.defaults.toml at theme root)

configSchema.description: JSON Schema for theme options in doki.toml

entries.description: Named client entry id → source path (e.g. .ts). Built via doki-bundler when that capability ships.
